reasoning: The agent set out an explicit milestone hierarchy (protocol loop → parser → symbol table → handlers) with concrete completion checks — a build-and-baseline gate for the foundation and a per-method pass-rate check for each subsequent layer — and sequenced methods by cost-to-pass/test-volume, deprioritizing the cheapest-to-skip (semantic tokens), which squarely matches the level-8 anchor.
